_note: 5-dimension quality rubric for the Critic, condensed from evaluation/prompts/agent_review_prompt.md so scores stay comparable to the project's phase-1 evaluation. Integer 1-7, anchored at 3. The Critic SCORES and SENDS BACK; it does not rewrite content.
scale: integer 1-7. 3 = the competent typical default and the corpus mode. MOST artifacts are 3. A 4 clears the per-dimension FAIL floor but is NOT a flagship move; PASS additionally requires >=1 dimension at >=5 (R9 / pass_requires_signature_move).

score_gates.4: requires >=2 distinct, concrete evidence items on the page
score_gates.5: requires >=3 evidence items AND the artifact visibly handling a category-typical failure mode
score_gates.6: rare; clearly above professional-typical on this dimension
score_gates.7: top ~1%, reference-class (indistinguishable from the best published work this year)

global_rules: R1 Anchor at 3 and re-anchor when scoring high: a 5+ must clear the score_gates above, not just 'feel good'.
R2 Vagueness penalty: a justification that names no concrete, on-page evidence caps the score at 3.
R3 Single-evidence cap: one nice touch is not a 5; breadth of evidence is required to go high.
R4 No average-padding: do not nudge a weak dimension up because the piece is good overall.
R5 Counter-evidence first: before scoring high, actively look for what's wrong; report it.
R6 Score only what is present in the artifact + its evidence chain. Do not credit intent, effort, or assumed tooling.
R7 Length/flourish is NOT quality: more words, more charts, more adjectives do not raise a score; clarity and substance do.

R8 Interactive-set quality, not count: a SET of interactives (hero centerpiece + supporting playgrounds) raises a score ONLY if EACH delivers a DISTINCT on-page cognitive update the reader produces. A playground that re-teaches a finding already made, that lets the reader produce nothing, or that was added for breadth is decoration — it caps visual_design and insight_value at 3, exactly like decorative media. Score the EARNED subset, never the count; NEVER average UP because there are 'many interactives.' Require exactly ONE clear hero the page is built around — a widget-pile with no dominant centerpiece caps insight_value at 3. (A dropped/inert/recompute-disagreeing supporting playground is the Auditor/Playtester's hard send-back; this rule is the purpose/abundance half.) CONVERSELY (the abundance floor, mirror of the richness floor; CONTRACT C-ABUNDANCE): on a visual OR computational topic, a SINGLE token interactive where the dataset clearly affords several distinct producible findings is UNDER-engagement — the hero PLUS a full earned supporting set (one supporting playground per distinct producible finding, each passing earned_test) is the flagship bar, and a lone-hero page on a rich multi-finding topic should not score insight_value above 3 on engagement grounds alone. The lever axis is COVERAGE of distinct producible findings (more EARNED is better); the guard axis is per-widget quality (unchanged — more UNEARNED is not). Reward earned breadth (distinct produced findings), never raw count; the earned-subset rule still removes every duplicate/dead widget.

R9 Signature-move floor (raised pass bar): a run PASSES only if every dimension >=4 AND at least ONE dimension >=5 (its five_plus_requires — a genuine signature move). A uniformly-competent page (all 4s) is COMPETENT, not flagship, and does NOT pass. Positive mirror of the caps: caps stop bad work; R9 requires one excellent move. Satisfiable on the honest axis for any topic (reframe / runnable-verify / personal-position / signature annotated chart) so it never forces decorative media (existing caps still bite any forced junk). Bounded: if the <=2-round loop can't reach a >=5, record 'competent, NOT flagship' and surface it — never loop forever, never downgrade-then-pass.

pass_requires_signature_move._what: The raised pass bar (C-FLAGSHIP). A run PASSES only if EVERY dimension >=4 (clears the per-dimension FAIL floor) AND AT LEAST ONE dimension >=5 — a genuine signature move (that dimension's five_plus_requires met). A uniformly-competent page (all dimensions exactly 4) is COMPETENT, not flagship, and does NOT pass: the positive reward clauses (each dimension's five_plus_requires) bite at the pass line, not just as nice-to-haves. Caps stop bad work; this floor requires one excellent move.

flagship_move_per_dimension.visual_design: five_plus_requires met: a coherent themed system across multiple chart types PLUS a design move (e.g. a signature annotated chart, a tasteful data_driven cinematic spine) that carries information the prose does not — not bootstrap-blue / purple-gradient-hero / soulless evenly-spaced cards.
flagship_move_per_dimension.narrative_pacing: five_plus_requires met: a deliberate arc with a reframe or callback; the lead is the most surprising thing; ends on tension/implication, not a summary.
flagship_move_per_dimension.data_method_transparency: five_plus_requires met: load-bearing claims trace to named code lines / data_tables / source URLs (verifier.json) AND concrete caveats are stated AND (for a derived/modelled headline) an honest validation is present; STRONGEST form = the reader can independently re-execute the headline via the in-page Inspector runnable-verify panel + a reproducible notebook (FAVORS computational topics).
flagship_move_per_dimension.claim_data_alignment: five_plus_requires met: every quantitative claim is bounded by the data; caveats appear where they matter; sample sizes / partial-period flags explicit; any level gap between a validation and the headline is named rather than implied.
flagship_move_per_dimension.insight_value: five_plus_requires met: a non-obvious finding or reframing that updates a careful reader, ideally an angle partly from outside the raw data (detective context); a personal-position interactive that lets the reader PRODUCE the finding strengthens it.

pass_requires_signature_move.honest_axis_satisfiable: The signature move is reachable for ANY topic on its honest axis, so it never forces decorative media. A dry/abstract/computational/privacy topic reaches >=5 via narrative (a reframe hook), data_method_transparency (the runnable-verify / in-page Inspector layer — which actively FAVORS computational topics), insight_value (a personal-position interactive the reader runs), or visual_design (a signature annotated chart + a tasteful data_driven cinematic spine) — NEVER by forcing a decorative or tonally-wrong asset. A forced decorative/tonally-wrong asset trips the EXISTING decorative-media / richness caps, which floor that dimension at 3, making it ineligible as the signature move. See ../../frontend-design/references/abstract_excellence.json for the honest dry-topic excellence moves.
pass_requires_signature_move.bounded_loop_terminal: The orchestrator revision loop is bounded at <=2 rounds. If after the rounds EVERY dimension is >=4 but NONE reached >=5, the honest terminal is pass=false, flagship=false, tier="competent": record 'competent, NOT flagship' and surface it — NEVER loop forever, and NEVER round a 4 up to 5 (or pad the average) to manufacture a pass.

visual_design.what: the artifact as a visual product: palette, typography, layout, whitespace, chart-type fit, polish; editorial (not default-template) feel.
visual_design.anchor3: Functional default - looks like a competent person used a charting library with sensible defaults.
visual_design.five_plus_requires: a coherent themed system across multiple chart types + a design move that carries information the prose doesn't; not 'bootstrap blue / purple-gradient hero / evenly-spaced soulless cards'.
visual_design.common_failure: decorative media that says nothing; chart streaks; templated sameness; an asset that declares no purpose (INFORM/IMMERSE), or whose declared purpose isn't actually delivered on the page, or was added only to cover a channel.
visual_design.richness_floor_cap: The INVERSE of the decorative-media cap: that cap punishes purposeless EXCESS; this one punishes IMPOVERISHMENT on a rich topic. On a topic where topic_profile.is_visual==true, CAP this dimension at 3 if the page took the impoverished path — ONE image + a flat static hero (not a dynamic/animated cover) + a generic topically-unrelated CC0 loop for BGM (rung 2 not climbed where a real best-fit anthem fits). A visual topic that under-delivers on every richness lever is not a competent visual product no matter how clean each piece is. The Critic CORROBORATES this floor (it does not own the gate — the orchestrator richness gate + validate.py richness_* checks own enforcement, and the floor never forces a fabricated/decorative asset, which itself caps visual_design at 3). [Mirrors PIT-45 (the impoverished path passing every gate) + PIT-46 (cinematic dropped for under-supply) + PIT-47 (generic loop where a real anthem fits); pairs with the auditor cinematic_supply_floor / dynamic_hero_on_visual / topic_asset_floor.]
visual_design.inert_immersion_cap: (EXTENDS the richness floor — coexists with the decorative/tonally-wrong cap; both can apply.) Cinematic and BGM are now MANDATORY stages on EVERY blog (not opt-in, no 'off', and BGM has NO exemption — not even privacy): every page ships a cinematic scroll background (photographic / generative / data_driven) AND opens with a fitting real BGM. So an INERT page is also an impoverishment failure regardless of is_visual: CAP this dimension at 3 if the cinematic scroll layer is EFFECTIVELY ABSENT (no real scroll background built, or a token immersion that does nothing) OR no BGM is present on ANY topic (BGM is mandatory universally; the license-clean classical-recording floor guarantees a fitting real track always exists, so its absence caps the dimension on every topic, privacy included). DISTINCT from the decorative/tonally-wrong cap: a present-but-tonally-WRONG immersion (a celebratory track on a sober topic, an atmosphere fighting the mood) is STILL capped at 3 by the decorative-media / ethos cap (making it present does not exempt it). REWARD the positive case: a tasteful, topic-appropriate scroll background + a restrained, tonally-fitting real BGM is a richness signal that helps lift toward 5+, not a checkbox. The Critic CORROBORATES; the orchestrator gate + validate.py cinematic_missing / bgm_missing own enforcement; the floor never forces a fabricated/decorative/tonally-wrong asset (which is itself the decorative cap).
visual_design.static_hero_cap: (EXTENDS the richness floor — the COVER half; coexists with the caps above.) The cover is the page's single most load-bearing detail (its hook), so on a topic where topic_profile.is_visual==true, CAP this dimension at 3 if the hero is STATIC-LOOKING or NON-LOOPING: a bare static still where motion was affordable, OR a technically-correct <video> that reads as a still (only a 'faint pulse' / 'thin clouds drift slowly' over an otherwise-static stadium/building — no clearly-visible primary motion), OR a clip that visibly JUMPS at the loop point (no seamless boomerang/crossfade loop; hero.json carries no `loop` marker). An animated treatment squandered on near-still motion or a jumping loop is not a competent visual product no matter how clean the rest is. REWARD the positive case: a dramatic, alive, seamlessly-looping topic-adaptive cover (bold flags/smoke/crowd/wheels motion, a clean loop) is a richness signal that lifts toward 5+. The Critic CORROBORATES; the auditor dynamic_hero_on_visual + validate.py richness_static_hero / hero_loop_marker_missing own enforcement; the cap never forces a fabricated/decorative motion with no source (which is itself the decorative cap). [Mirrors PIT-52 (subtle cinemagraph reads as static / no seamless loop) + PIT-45 (the impoverished path); pairs with hero_recipes.json build_recipe.animate + topic_motion_library.]
visual_design.also: programmer (if the issue is rendering/layout fidelity, not the design choice)

narrative_pacing.what: the author as tour guide: hook, ordering, rhythm, ending; is there a real structural move beyond setup -> data -> conclusion?
narrative_pacing.anchor3: Three-act competence: readable but unsurprising in shape; no structural move.
narrative_pacing.five_plus_requires: a deliberate arc with a reframe or callback; the lead is the most surprising thing; ends on tension/implication, not a summary.
narrative_pacing.common_failure: pre-spoiled thesis in the standfirst; background-first opening; flat enumeration.
narrative_pacing.titling_caption_cap: The titles + captions carry the hook, so a templated/AI-tell titling layer is a narrative failure, not a cosmetic one. CAP this dimension at 3 if ANY of: (a) a GENERIC / TEMPLATED headline or section heading — the AT1 two-beat ('Flat statement. Flat counter-statement.' / 'not X, it's Y', e.g. 'Argentina is the favourite. No bookmaker agrees.'), an 'An Analysis of …' / 'Exploring …' / 'Understanding …' topic label, an empty (data-unbacked) superlative, or a reflexive colon subtitle; (b) a standfirst/dek that PRE-SPOILS the reveal number the interactive hero exists to make the reader PRODUCE; (c) a CAPTION that only labels the axes / opens 'This chart shows' / 'the x-axis shows' / 'is pictured' instead of stating the finding (chart caption should be a takeaway-title + metric subtitle; photo = who/what/where + absolute date, then why); or (d) a MARKETING word (novel / unprecedented / groundbreaking / state-of-the-art / first-to) or PaperDoctor tic in any h1/h2/figcaption. A piece can have a sound arc and still squander its most-read lines on machine-default titles — that caps narrative_pacing at 3 regardless of body structure. Send the fix to the **copywriter** (re-title the masthead / sections / captions to copywriter.json). The Critic CORROBORATES; the advisory enforcement is the auditor check_15_titling_caption_quality grep + the 错题本 PIT-56/57/58 (it is intentionally NOT a hard validate.py gate yet). REWARD the positive case: a headline that states the conclusion on a real device + a standfirst that primes without spoiling + takeaway-title captions is a narrative signal that helps lift toward 5. [Mirrors PIT-56 (templated headline) / PIT-57 (standfirst spoils the hero reveal) / PIT-58 (axis-only caption); pairs with the auditor check_15_titling_caption_quality + report_types titling_generic_headline / caption_states_no_finding.]
narrative_pacing.also: copywriter (when the failing dimension is the titling/captioning layer — a templated headline, a pre-spoiling standfirst, or an axis-only caption — re-titled in copywriter.json, not the body the Editor owns)

data_method_transparency.what: procedural credibility: (a) sources cited with specifics, (b) methodology described, (c) data/code accessible/traceable AND re-runnable, (d) limitations/caveats concrete.
data_method_transparency.anchor3: Some sourcing, but a motivated reader could not reconstruct how a number was produced.
data_method_transparency.five_plus_requires: claims trace to named code lines / data_tables / source URLs (use verifier.json), AND concrete caveats are stated; for a derived/modelled/predictive headline, an explicit validation (backtest / baseline comparison / sanity check) is present and honest about what it does not show. REWARD the runnable coding verifier when the reader can actually re-execute the statement, not just read its provenance: the in-page Inspector panel lets the reader open any load-bearing number and 'run it yourself' (a computation snippet that re-executes in-browser and grades against the published output, stochastic ones graded '≈ within noise'), AND a reproducible notebook re-runs the headline numbers from raw data and asserts they match. A headline that is both traceable (verifier.json) AND independently re-runnable by the reader is the strongest form of this dimension.
data_method_transparency.common_failure: round numbers with no provenance; missing caveats; data-driven claim with no calculation; a derived/modelled/predictive headline asserted with no validation, sanity check, or honest limits; provenance shown but nothing the reader can actually re-execute (no working in-page run / no reproducible notebook) — traceable-but-not-runnable is weaker than runnable.
data_method_transparency.material_caveat_survival_cap: Check that MATERIAL caveats/limitations survived into the VISIBLE prose, not just the JSONs. A material caveat is one that could change the lead finding's direction or magnitude (e.g. a model assumption that biases the headline's own subject, or a Detective controversy/limitation bearing on the lead). If such a caveat is in analyst.json/detective.json/editor.json but is dropped from the page, reduced to a stray clause, or buried in a footnote, CAP this dimension at 3 — provenance does not redeem a headline whose known material limitation never reaches the reader.
data_method_transparency.honest_accuracy_cap: For an accuracy / skill / 'the model is right X% of the time' claim, check it is shown with an HONEST baseline comparison and that no unflattering result is hidden. CAP this dimension at 3 if EITHER: (a) the page asserts the model's accuracy/skill with NO naive baseline beside it (chance / always-favourite / last-value / market-implied) so the reader cannot tell whether the model beats the dumb default — a skill number without a yardstick is not transparent; OR (b) an unflattering, material result is suppressed while a flattering framing is kept (a tiny n the accuracy rests on, a backtest where the model barely beats or loses to naive, a cherry-picked window). The honest move is to show the model BESIDE the baseline and state the small-sample limit; a one-sided accuracy boast caps at 3 even if the number itself traces. [Mirrors auditor flagship_contract.json honest_model_scorecard (E2), which sends the same defect back to the Analyst as a hard miss — corroborate, don't double-route.]
data_method_transparency.also: editor (if the caveat exists in the JSONs but the Editor dropped/buried it in the prose); programmer (if provenance exists in JSON but isn't surfaced via data-* tags)

claim_data_alignment.what: substantive credibility: are quantitative claims actually bounded by what the data supports? correlation not dressed as causation?
claim_data_alignment.anchor3: Claims broadly match the data but some are loosely scoped or slightly over-reach.
claim_data_alignment.five_plus_requires: every quantitative claim is bounded by the data; caveats appear where they matter; sample sizes / partial-period flags are explicit; where a validation confirms a different granularity than the headline claims (e.g. per-event skill vs an aggregate/tournament-level figure), the prose names that level gap rather than implying the headline number itself was validated.
claim_data_alignment.common_failure: causal language over correlational data; unbounded extrapolation; a headline number contradicted by its own chart; presenting a validated lower-level result as if it validated the higher-level headline; a 'disagreement' with an external benchmark oversold without noting it is partly a snapshot artefact (different as-of date / method / sample).
claim_data_alignment.material_caveat_survival_cap: Same check as data_method_transparency: if a MATERIAL limitation of the lead (one that could move its direction or magnitude) is present in the JSONs but dropped or buried in the visible prose, the headline over-reaches its own honest scope — CAP this dimension at 3.
claim_data_alignment.cite_third_party_as_theirs_cap: Check that data/results sourced from a THIRD PARTY are presented as that party's, not as the project's own. CAP this dimension at 3 if the page presents an external party's data, index, forecast, or finding as if the project produced or owns it — e.g. a market/bookmaker line, an official body's forecast, another outlet's chart or ranking, or a proprietary index shown without naming its source and framed as 'our number / our model / we found'. The honest move is to attribute it (named source + link) and to keep the project's OWN derived numbers visibly distinct from the borrowed ones. Presenting a third party's figure as the project's own is a substantive credibility failure regardless of polish. [Pairs with auditor PIT-10 (derive your OWN auditable index, never lift a proprietary one) and the model_vs_market snapshot-honesty note — attribute the benchmark, don't absorb it.]
claim_data_alignment.also: analyst (if the underlying finding/number itself is wrong or unsupported)

insight_value.what: does the reader gain a non-trivial cognitive update? (Bloom: knowledge < comprehension < synthesis/evaluation).
insight_value.anchor3: Confirms what an informed reader likely already assumed; mostly description.
insight_value.five_plus_requires: a non-obvious finding or reframing that updates a careful reader; ideally an angle that comes partly from outside the raw data (detective context).
insight_value.common_failure: data restated without a point; the 'so what' is missing; a model/derived headline the reader cannot run or verify themselves; interaction bolted on after the reveal instead of letting the reader produce the finding; a SET of interactives where some re-teach the same finding or the reader produces nothing from them (decoration — score the earned subset, never the count, per R8); a widget-pile with no clear hero centerpiece the page is built around (caps at 3).
insight_value.richness_floor_cap: Same richness floor as visual_design, applied to the experience the reader gets: on a topic where topic_profile.is_visual==true, CAP this dimension at 3 if the page took the impoverished path (ONE image + a static hero + a generic unrelated CC0 loop). An impoverished visual treatment robs the reader of the immersive cognitive update a rich topic affords, so a thin delivery cannot score high on insight even if the underlying finding is sound. ALSO (cinematic + BGM are now MANDATORY stages, no 'off', and BGM has NO exemption — not even privacy): an INERT page robs the reader regardless of is_visual — CAP at 3 if the cinematic scroll layer is effectively absent or no BGM is present on ANY topic (BGM is mandatory universally; the license-clean classical-recording floor guarantees a fitting real track always exists). A present-but-tonally-WRONG immersion stays capped by the decorative cap; a tasteful topic-appropriate immersion is rewarded (the two caps coexist). The Critic corroborates the floor; it does not own the gate (orchestrator richness gate + validate.py richness_* / cinematic_missing / bgm_missing checks enforce it), and the floor never forces a fabricated/decorative/tonally-wrong asset (which itself caps at 3). [Mirrors PIT-45/46/47; inverse of the decorative-media / widget-pile caps that punish purposeless excess.]
insight_value.also: detective (when the missing lever is outside-the-data context/angle)

ethos: Reward GENUINE quality: clarity, a real angle, accurate well-bounded claims, traceable evidence, distinctive design.

Do NOT reward length, more charts, flourish, or marketing tone. Penalize forbidden marketing words (novel, state-of-the-art, unprecedented, groundbreaking, revolutionary, first-to) and PaperDoctor tics (Holistic, Evidence-grounded as a frame, Hierarchical, L1/L2/L3).
Do NOT reward visual/media sameness across blogs or decorative media that carries no information.

Every media asset must earn a purpose: INFORM (carries data/information the prose cannot) or IMMERSE (sets mood/atmosphere that aids reading). An asset with no declared purpose, an undelivered purpose, or one added only to fill a channel is decoration — it caps visual_design at 3 regardless of polish.
Verify each load-bearing claim/asset against its evidence chain (verifier.json: code lines / data_tables / source URLs) BEFORE scoring transparency and claim-data alignment.
Be specific and surgical in send-backs: name the exact section/finding/asset and the minimal change; never ask for 'make it better'.
